scenes.title: Choose your language
scenes.caption: First screen: Kannada, Hindi, Telugu or English, each written and spoken in its own language.

scenes.title: Login and demo accounts
scenes.caption: Phone-number login with one-tap Try Demo Mode and Officer demo buttons.

scenes.title: Farmer home (desktop)
scenes.caption: District weather card, nearby pest alerts and picture tiles; sidebar navigation on larger screens.

scenes.title: Farmer home (phone)
scenes.caption: The same home on a phone: greeting, district weather, rain chance and a pest-alert banner.

scenes.title: Six picture tiles
scenes.caption: Weather, Which crop?, Fertilizer, Pest photo, Alerts and Ask, each with a read-aloud button.

scenes.title: Instant language switch
scenes.caption: The whole app, district names and pest names included, switched to Kannada.

scenes.title: Weather station
scenes.caption: Current conditions, 7-day farm weather alerts and today's temperature curve for the farmer's district.

scenes.title: 16-day farm forecast
scenes.caption: AI farm decisions (sowing, irrigation, spray safety, crop health) next to the 16-day forecast.

scenes.title: Crop recommender inputs
scenes.caption: Precision Model tab: N, P, K, temperature, humidity, pH and rainfall.

scenes.title: Crop recommendation
scenes.caption: Rice at 99.7% confidence from the AgriQNet v3 quantum-hybrid model (7 simulated qubits).

scenes.title: Fertilizer calculator
scenes.caption: GenAI fertilizer plan with picture buttons for the target crop.

scenes.title: Fertilizer recommendation
scenes.caption: Urea from N/P/K via the quantum-hybrid fertilizer model (3 simulated qubits).

scenes.title: Pest photo: step 1
scenes.caption: Take a photo or choose one from the gallery, with spoken guidance.

scenes.title: Pest identified
scenes.caption: YOLOv8 (IP102, 102 classes) names the pest from the photo.

scenes.title: What to do now
scenes.caption: Host crop, detector confidence (68%) and plain-language control steps.

scenes.title: Warn nearby farmers
scenes.caption: Pick how bad it is: very bad (2 districts away), spreading (neighbours) or a few pests (this district).

scenes.title: Who gets the SMS
scenes.caption: Breadth-first search over the district graph previews the districts that will be texted.

scenes.title: Alerts for my district
scenes.caption: Active pest warnings for the farmer's district, with report and map shortcuts.

scenes.title: Weather alerts and basic-phone SMS
scenes.caption: Rule-based weather warnings and SMS for a family member's basic phone.

scenes.title: Alert Network map
scenes.caption: Karnataka district map: red, orange and yellow zones around a reported outbreak, with district details.

scenes.title: Officer view
scenes.caption: Agriculture officer dashboard: districts, registered farmers, active alerts and alert history.

scenes.title: Farmer Library
scenes.caption: A streaming-style shelf of farm books and reports, with search, Ask the whole library and Add a book.

scenes.title: Ask a book
scenes.caption: AgriRAG answers from one book with numbered page citations.

scenes.title: Ask anything
scenes.caption: Agri Assistant answers district-specific farming questions, with suggested topics and read-aloud.
